messages:
Eli_Sales: Sparrow just asked for an accelerated POC to validate sustained throughput + tail latency for a chat feature. Target they gave: sustained 600 qps, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms, seq len ~256. They want a run this Thurs 09:00 PST. Can we commit?

Priya_SE: I can lead coordination. Proposed approach: hosted sandbox but reserve a Dedicated pool for the hot window (to minimize noisy neighbor noise). Quick load plan: ramp 0->600 qps in 8 min, hold 45 min, 3x 30s microspikes to 900 qps, then cooldown. Payload mix: 60% mid (128 tokens), 40% long (256 tokens).

Priya_SE: Example bench command (uses our internal loadgen):
```bash
loadgen --url https://api.redwood.test --model redwood-medium-8k-quant \
  --mix-file workloads/sparrow_mix.json --qps 600 --ramp 480 --hold 2700 \
  --report-dir /tmp/sparrow-2026-03-POC
```

Theo_Eng: Engine notes:
- redwood-medium-8k-quant should hit the target on 4x H100-80GB dedicated nodes for this mixture, assuming KV caching enabled.
- Expect p99 delta vs fp16 of ~+6-10% on pathological long sequences.
- If they insist on hard p99 cap, we should enable soft preemption + fallback to a smaller model to keep latency.

Marco_Infra: Infra checklist / ops items:
- Need sandbox quota bump to 1k qps for the tenant (I can apply immediately).
- If we use Dedicated pool for the hold window, provisioning lead time: 24-48 hours to guarantee nodes.
- Networking: they asked about VPC endpoint and private connectivity. VPC peering + ephemeral routing adds ~2 business days for approvals.

Eli_Sales: Pricing question from Sparrow: what will this cost for the 1-hr dedicated hot window + sandbox usage? Need a ballpark to get internal approval.

Theo_Eng: Ballpark: 4x H100 reserved for 2 hours (prep + run) = approx $X,XXX (compute delta). Token cost depends on model and actual token count; estimate ~$200 for tokens for the test given the mix. I'll convert to a tidy quote once Priya confirms exact model variant.

Priya_SE: I'll capture exact durations and attach the sample mix. Also preparing the runbook sections: smoke, ramp, soak, spike, rollback, artifact collection (logs, traces, GPU metrics, bench report).

Marco_Infra: Security / KMS note: we support cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) today and customer-managed keys. HSM-backed wrap (customer HSM) is supported as an add-on but requires approval and config changes (est ~5 business days). I submitted a short security blurb we can use in the questionnaire.

sec-bot: Security ticket created: SEC-2026-204 Sparrow POC - KMS/HSM and network questions. Assigned to @security-team. https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-2026-204

Eli_Sales: Action items: (1) Priya - runbook + bench command + link to workload file by EOD tomorrow; (2) Marco - confirm Dedicated provisioning ETA and post the KMS blurb; (3) Theo - produce the quick cost delta (compute + token) as a $/hour estimate. I'll inform Sparrow we can do Thurs 09:00 PST pending infra confirmation.

Priya_SE: I'll do a micro-smoke today at 50 qps to validate the request path and metrics pipeline. If anyone wants to join, 20m slot starting in 15m.

Theo_Eng: I'll join the smoke. Also will run a quick sim to compare quant vs fp16 on a 50-call sample and post latency histograms.

Marco_Infra: Requested quota bump applied for sandbox tenant. If we need Dedicated guarantee, please confirm by EOD to hit the 24-48h window.

Eli_Sales: Confirmed - prioritizing Dedicated reservation. Priya/Theo/Marco thanks. I'll loop in Sparrow AEs after we have the runbook. :thumbsup:

Priya_SE: Thanks team - runbook draft will include Grafana dashboard links (latency heatmap, p99 trend, GPU util) and a Slack alert rule for p99 > 350ms.

Theo_Eng: Posting results artifact checklist now: bench JSON, raw latency samples, perf trace, model cfg, node util snapshots, and a short summary note.

Eli_Sales: Perfect. Closing here for now, will post updates in this thread.
